title: Shyam Bahadur Singh made a big announcement before winning the election, will dance on elephant on 10th: Siwan News

asr.full_text: In both hands, we fought with each other. And we fought until the end. In this, I think that he will still come! In which he left Delhi and went to Bombay. It would be a pity that he would not have held any election. We would want freedom! Freedom of the trade! I want the state's freedom and freedom for all people. What are your thoughts on winning? I thank the channel, Debtu for this. Our children, all of them had to go there, and I thought how will these kids go without any financial support? Those who don't have the money, cannot travel from there? It has to be paid back. We need that. Like we have to do for the security of our community, we also need that. we will also get a job in our town. What do you think now, even though your wife never said she will give birth to more than one children, what you feel now? I am also trying, I have already found the brother for this, How are you feeling now? Happy? Yes, I also feel proud, We are very happy, It was a very strong fight. But I said it's me, not my work. He did it not the way he did it. He got the job because he didn't have an auto or a car. Did he do it on purpose? Yes. Why did they do it? What else can he do if he doesn't have a job after 10 years! It's difficult to work while taking the bus. I work two days from now and I get stuck twice. So after two days, he is sure to win? I am sure! If you see this, that person will pick their own curtain. So what? And he will cut this tree in half.. ..what's that all about? As long as a person lives like this, an elephant'll come on his shoulder and he'll ride a horse as well. In that case, what's the next move? Can't a poor man have a heart to ride an elephant? Why not? After all, it is only like that. A elephant will definitely come, right? A mountain will move it right? What then? Then who would ride an elephant? Then who will ride an elephant? They are not only in power, people who see that he is in power will turn into money. But you will have on beating her up. Who can handle this now. This may even cause the future of a farm to change. They are not able to teach us. They have been teaching us for 3 hours. We have been working for hours. We have been working for hours. We have been working for hours. We have been working for hours. We have been working for hours. We have been working for hours. We have been working for hours. We have been working for hours. We have been my job well. I am not sure if I where we have to give a lot of money to the people. The minister made us rich and rich, and we are making money out of it. The minister will make you a minister, what will you do under such circumstances? I will fight with him. How will you fight against the minister? With him? With the minister? He is old, he's not a great man. We'll work against him. We'll take revenge and learn our lesson. With the help of people? with the help of people. You want to become a Minister? What can one do? I just want to buy the goods and make a king. Do you think that after becoming a minister Minister and become the king of the land without any other reason. Even your people will become the Minister in the future, right? A few people will become the minister, but who will become the president? The ministers... Truth will be in the transfer, the postings, this or that. They will take the responsibility from Kabin have moved the party that way. Are you sure we are going to succeed? You asked me if I will move the party. Yes. When my age will be good then I will leave this house. Bye.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a local election news interview, with a man addressing multiple news microphones and labels identifying news outlets. Its discussion concerns political topics such as winning, ministers, jobs, land, and political conditions, with no described promotion of payment, investment, credential request, or linked participation flow.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The supplied evidence supports general local news and political interview content, rather than a scam mechanism or financial promotion.
